what: The Run v5d: camera keys for the one continuous shot (Fable, 2026-10-26). Keys sit on marble-timeline.json frames; the marble, the bake, the lamp and the ending are unchanged from v5c. Trimmed copy for the build (source: Agentique reports/briefs/title-v5d/camera-v5d-keys.json). Builder departures are marked builder_note.

lens.note: one prime for the whole shot; record_pose is calibrated at 50 mm

frame_of_reference: table frame (channel_v5c): metres, origin at the top's near-left corner, x along the 3.0 m length, y away from the near edge, z up from the oak top

unchanged: every sheet, the galley, the coins, the weights, the globe
the stick chart stays on the wall at x 1.10-1.90
the release block, channel, leather, steps, felt, well and record (physics and A7)
layout.admiralty_weight: none: its roll holds it; give the open corner nearest reach 3 a 1.5 mm lift (flat_sheet lift) so it reads as a sheet unrolled and left
layout.ino_admiralty_on_reach_2: solved by the camera: far-side camera with the marble in the lower frame; the band-B sheet edge that enters the bottom 5% of frame is the blank margin at 0.3 m, 20-30 px soft

conventions.rel: eye = marble + D * (cos(el) cos(h+az), cos(el) sin(h+az), sin(el)); h = the marble's heading from the bake (atan2 of the position 3 frames ahead minus 3 frames behind); az negative = to the marble's right
conventions.abs: eye given in the table frame
conventions.marble_screen: [sx, sy]: where the marble sits in the frame, as fractions of width and height from the centre, + right / + up. The aim (look_at) is solved per frame so the marble lands there: look_at = eye + f * |marble - eye| where f is the forward direction that projects the marble at (sx, sy); up = +z until the ending
conventions.interpolation: eye: smootherstep between consecutive keys. sx, sy, f-stop, focus distance: smootherstep between keys. The aim is recomputed EVERY frame from the marble's actual position (never interpolate look_at between keys). Opening: eye blends from key 0 to key 90 with smootherstep(f/90); the aim blends from key 0's look_at to the marble-placed aim with smootherstep(f/48). Ending: from frame 927 the whole pose blends toward record_pose(rec) exactly as shot_v5c does (b = smootherstep((t - (t_rest - 0.5)) / ((t_end - 1.0) - (t_rest - 0.5)))), up from +z to +y, f-stop to 5.6, focus to the sheet; pose at 1061, held to 1090.
conventions.focus: 'marble' = eye-to-marble distance; '<point>' = eye-to-point distance (a rack); 'split:<point>' = harmonic mean of the two distances (the stop then carries both)
conventions.rack_limit: the marble may be soft only while its blur diameter <= 0.5 of its own image diameter (measured here: <= 0.33), its image >= 90 px, on a straight, at <= 0.30 m/s, never through a step or a bank; a rack lasts <= 0.5 s out, <= 0.5 s hold, <= 0.4 s back

keys.beat: B0 opening wide (whole run), descending to B1 over 3.0 s
B3 the Atlas enters behind the marble
B4 L3: the marble slows abeam
B4 back to the marble, leaving
B5 traverse along the table's end
B5 traverse; the Atlas left, the marble right
B6 the jeton on the Atlas corner, beside the groove
B7 L4 rack to the leaf
B10 exit; the camera begins to drift to the wall side
B11 crossing ahead of the marble
B11 lead: the weights beside the marble, the globe behind
B11 L6 rack to the weights
B12 the pass; the Ino revealed
B12 L7 rack to the Ino

keys.builder_note: moved from frame 815 (Fable) to 816: 815-830 is 15 frames = 0.5005 s, over the 0.5 s rack hold; 816 holds 0.467 s and the pull out takes 0.367 s (under 0.5)

keys.beat: B15 lip; the ending's blend starts at 927

checks.marble_in_frame: frames 0-975 (leaves the frame during the ending's move onto the record, as in v5c)
checks.render_cost_estimate: prefix 1091 x 8.1 s = 2.45 h; per-film extra 2 x 271 x ~9 s = 1.35 h; wides (turn breaths, ~250 frames) +~3 s each = +0.2 h; meter 70 s; total about 4.0 h at 512 spp
